code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    markers = [(i,j,v) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v != bg]
    # Seed color is the unique interior object, changed to 4; fill the rectangular span of opposite edge markers.
    seed_colors = [v for i,j,v in markers if 0 < i < h-1 and 0 < j < w-1]
    fill = seed_colors[0] if seed_colors else next(v for i,j,v in markers)
    ys=[i for i,j,v in markers]; xs=[j for i,j,v in markers]
    for i in range(min(ys), max(ys)+1):
        for j in range(min(xs), max(xs)+1):
            if out[i][j] == bg: out[i][j] = fill
    for i,j,v in markers:
        if v == fill and 0 < i < h-1 and 0 < j < w-1: out[i][j] = 4
    return out
'''
